title: Forge transport retry policy direction
rationale: pr-merge's direction (retry network/5xx/429, other 4xx fatal) beats pr-open's inverse because a 401/403 must surface an expired credential loudly per forge-contract §4, not be retried into silence

name: forge-p1-migration-recipe
description: Phase-1 migration recipe (steps 2-5 of pl-d1c9): replace private GITHUB_API_BASE/buildHeaders/readJson/readText/truncate copies with src/forge/github/ requestGitHub + GITHUB_API_BASE + readJson; map GitHubHttpError kind network->network else http_error to preserve the caller's existing result taxonomy; pass userAgent + a short context label. Adopting the shared retry policy adds retry where none existed — tests must supply maxRetries+1 canned failure responses (recordingFetch throws when exhausted). The domain PR-body clamp is clampPrBodyLength in pr-template.ts; annotate paths re-clamp through it, never inline.

title: Per-call-site retry adoption on the forge transport
rationale: One shared policy direction (transient=network/5xx/429, 4xx fatal), but whether in-band retries run depends on whether an outer poller already owns retry for that call.

content: warren-2740: scripts/acceptance/lib/github.ts imports buildGitHubHeaders/GITHUB_API_BASE from src/forge/github/. check:layers does not walk scripts/, so importing the seam (not re-implementing) keeps api.github.com literals out of scripts/ without widening WALK_ROOTS. GITHUB_TOKEN ownership: bootInProc PASSTHROUGH_ENV_KEYS passes it to the booted warren, which owns it (auto-open-PR, CI-fixer poller, push auth); the harness borrows it only for scenario 35 cleanup. Scenario 12 blanks it via extraEnv; 26/36 use WARREN_GH_FETCH_OVERRIDE=merged.

name: forge-transport-migration-recipe
description: Forge phase-1 transport migrations (plan pl-d1c9): consumers call requestGitHub from src/forge/github/http.ts with userAgent + context label, import GITHUB_API_BASE from headers.ts, and expose a retry?: GitHubRetryOptions passthrough so tests inject sleep:async()=>{} to stay fast. Shared recordingFetch/jsonResponse helpers live in src/forge/github/test-helpers.ts; jsonResponse takes (status, body), opposite of several legacy local copies.

Dispatching a plan's children as sequential warren runs collides in .seeds/issues.jsonl on every PR after the first: .gitattributes sets merge=union, which for a JSONL whose rows are rewritten in place (closing one issue rewrites blockedBy on every plan sibling) silently emits two contradictory copies of every touched row and reports a clean merge. 8 dup rows on the first collision, 20 on each later one across pl-d1c9's 19 children.
resolution: Resolve by taking the closed status where either side closed and INTERSECTING blockedBy across the two rows — each side only ever removes a blocker, so taking either row alone resurrects one the other side already satisfied (seen on umbrella seed warren-3fe7, where main dropped warren-4e78 and the branch dropped warren-0993). Verify with 'jq -r .id .seeds/issues.jsonl | sort | uniq -d' after every merge, then 'bun run check:seeds-integrity'. Filed warren-9c90 (merge driver) and warren-db8c (denormalized blockedBy).

name: plan-child-dispatch-prompt
description: Dispatch prompts for a plan child whose seed description is only a plan backref stub must name the design-doc SECTION as the spec, not the seed. pl-d1c9's 19 children all carry identical stub descriptions; the real spec is docs/design/forge-contract.md. Prompts citing exact sections (§6.1 drift inventory, §6.5 retry disagreement, §6.14 token gap) produced agents that made and DOCUMENTED the intended judgment calls; the seed alone specifies nothing.

title: Forge transport retry adopts the pr-merge direction
rationale: forge-contract §3 assigns semantic retry to the domain and transport retry to the forge. Retrying 4xx inside transport hides the expired-credential 401/403 signal the §4 credential campaign must surface loudly, so transport treats non-rate-limit 4xx as fatal.
